value.rationale: Rank is the dimension of E^2 and the fundamental natural stratification separating perfect from nonperfect evolution algebras. Exact idempotent-count distribution for every singular rank is a natural complete invariant of this random-algebra family; finite-q variation and GL_s(F2) asymptotic universality provide structural information not supplied by full-rank results.
